Frequently asked questions

Which crypto inheritance tool is best?

Our top pick is Casa. See each tool's verdict for who it suits and who should skip it.

Are there free crypto inheritance options?

Yes: Liana, Nunchuk have a free option. Check the official pricing page before you buy.

Which of these work outside the US?

Casa, AnchorWatch, Liana, Vault12 Guard, Ledger Recover are available globally. Unchained are US-focused.
